sentences.translation: # Don't be too much.
Yui goes to the department store with her father today.
There are 10,000 yen for Yuinosaifu.
to buy a present for her, her grandmother, grandpa, and three other men.
I wonder if I can buy three for 10,000 yen," Yui walks with concern.
The entrance to the department store is very large.
The automatic door opens and the widow and father enter.
"Wow!" says the yummy.
The department store is glittering and smells good.
First, there is a jewelry corner on the first floor.
Yui looks inside the showcase.
There are many large gems.
"Daughter, how much is that?"
"It's a million yen ring," says the father.
"One million yen!" is a surprise.
The necklaces are also priced.
One million yen.
"One million yen is too expensive," Yui thinks.
All the jewels are a million yen or higher.
You can't buy jewelry for 10,000 yen.
"I can't make jewelry a present," Yui notices.
But the jewels are so beautiful that you can watch them for a while.
Next, I go upstairs.
The second floor is a corner for bags and wallets.
An old man takes a purse.
"A 100,000 yen wallet?" says the father.
"Hyakken!" Yui is surprised again.
I think you can buy anything for a hundred thousand yen.
But now, there are only 10,000 yen.
A hundred thousand yen wallet is ten times higher than a ten thousand yen wallet.
Large leather wallets and small leather wallets cost about 100,000 yen.
"What about a 20,000 yen bag?" Yui says.
But it's not worth the 20,000 yen.
You may buy three presents if you pay 20,000 yen, so you should be careful.
I'll just look at my 100,000 yen wallet and 20,000 yen bag today.
"There are some shops that are not enough even if they have 20,000 yen," Yui murmured.
20,000 yen feels like a distant number.
The third floor is a corner of a barber.
There are a lot of TVs on the table.
Big TVs, small TVs, all are amazing.
"How much is this TV?" Yui asks.
When you look at the price tag, it says 100,000 yen.
"The TV is also 100,000 yen," says the father.
A small TV will cost you 100,000 yen.
"You can't do TV too," says Yui, laughing.
There are high prices on the third floor of the department store.
I imagine the face that Yui Oji looks happy while watching a TV of 100,000 yen.
But I can't buy it today.
Go upstairs.
The fourth floor is a corner of a stool.
Yui sees a sweater.
There is a sweater for 4,000 yen.
"You can buy 4,000 yen!" Yui says with joy.
My mother likes blue sweaters.
Take a 4,000 yen blue sweater and watch it well.
It's soft and pleasant.
"I wonder if your mother will wear a 4,000 yen sweater," Yui asks her father.
"I think it's good," says the father.
Put a 4,000 yen sweater in the basket.
Now, the 6,000 yen, which is less than 4,000 yen, remains in Yuinosaifu.
You have to buy two more presents for 6,000 yen.
You should think carefully.
The fifth floor is a corner of the bunbogu.
I have a lot of stamps.
There are various kinds of stamps, such as 84 yen stamps and 94 yen stamps.
"Grandpa is collecting stamps," Yui recalls.
There is a set of beautiful picture stamps.
When you look at the price tag, it says 400 yen.
"The four hundred yen stamp set!" Yui smiles.
Four hundred yen still leaves money.
There is also a postcard set of 400 yen.
It may be used with stamps.
There are also cute seals for 200 yen.
Yui picks up a four hundred yen stamp set for her grandfather.
Put a 200 yen seal in a basket.
"The price is 400 yen and 200 yen, 600 yen," Yui calculates.
Now, the basket includes a 4,000 yen sweater, a 400 yen stamp set and a 200 yen seal.
The total amount of money is 4,000 yen.
If you withdraw \400 from \10,000, you will remain \500," Yui says calmly.
I haven't bought a present for my grandma yet.
See more corners of the bun-bog.
There is a 40 yen eraser.
Forty yen is very cheap.
A small 40-yen eraser is held in the hand.
It has a cute shape.
I wonder if there are a few presents for 40 yen.
Gently put the 40 yen eraser back.

But there are also 40 yen notebooks and 40 yen 
Forty yen is a very good price.
If there were four things of 40 yen, it would be one hundred and sixty yen," Yui calculates in his head.
Go back to the corner of the sip.
Look for a present for grandma.
There is a small scarf.
It's a 4,000 yen scarf.
But if you use 4,000 yen, the total amount of money will be 8,000,600 yen.
The rest is 1,000 yen.
Four hundred yen may be used for the money to eat shaved ice.
"Is it all 86 million yen? Yes, it's OK!" I think.
"Daddy, I want to eat shaved ice," says Yui.
"It's okay. Let's go to the food court on the sixth floor," says the father.
The sixth floor of the department store is a food court.
There is a shaved ice shop.
Strawberry shaved ice, mango shaved ice, and Uji shaved ice are all beautiful.
I order strawberry shaved ice.
"The price is 500 yen," says the shop's person.
The 500 yen shaved ice is large and sweet.
My father will have a mango shaved ice.
The mango shaved ice is also 500 yen.
Two people pay 500 yen each.
I will give you one 500 yen coin from the yuinosai-fu.
"The 500 yen coin is heavy and cool," Yui says.
The 500 yen shaved ice and the 500 yen coin fit perfectly.
Today's shaved ice is especially delicious," says Yui while eating.
Eating shaved ice makes Yui healthy again.
The town below can be seen from the department store's food court.
"Department stores are big," Yui says while eating shaved ice.
After eating shaved ice, Yuito and her father go to the cash register.
Place the present in the basket on the counter.
4,000 yen sweater, 400 yen stamp set, 200 yen seal, 400 yen scarf.
"The total price is 8,000,000 yen," says the cashier.
Yui will pay 10,000 yen.
"I'll keep 10,000 yen. The price is 86.6 yen, so the price is 140 yen."
The cashier gives you a thousand yen bill and four hundred yen.
Four hundred yen is a hundred yen coin.
"It's a four hundred yen otatsuri," Yui counts.
"One hundred yen, two hundred yen, three hundred yen, four hundred yen."
A thousand yen and a hundred yen, together, a thousand and four hundred yen are in the hands of Yui.
"I calculated the price perfectly!" says Yui.
The father laughs.
"You're so smart. You could buy so many for 10,000 yen."
Yui cherishes the present's furrow.
"My mother and I have a 4,000 yen sweater. Grandpa and I have a four hundred yen stamp and a two hundred yen seal. Grandma and a 4,000 yen scarf. I hope everyone will be happy."
Before leaving the department store, Yui sees the jewelry corner again.
A million yen ring is still glittering.
"I want to save one million yen and give my mother jewelry," Yui thinks.
One million yen is a very distant dream now.
But it is free to have dreams.
"Daddy, I'm glad you came to the department store today," says Yui.
"The department store is a good place," says the father.
Two people walk towards home, out of a large entrance to a department store.
The yui hand is a gift cup, and the father's hand is a small cup of shaved ice.
It was a very good day.
